decisions.summary: Wave 6 is the 32 open E0 rows (every open E0 row of ranking.json, all found by the wave 4/5 re-checks), claim lines only
decisions.why: E0 is the lowest open tier (32 open E0, then 87 E1); the 32 rows in tasks.md Phase 7 are exactly the open E0 rows of ranking.json, none held back (FR-006, SC-003).

decisions.summary: No review occasion, no map regeneration and no perf bookend for wave 6
decisions.why: Claim lines move nothing a map draws; FR-005's occasions and the plan's bookend rule apply only to waves that change engine behavior.

decisions.summary: A relabel never carries a code change; where the named page answers differently from the code, the claim states the code against the page and the departure is ranked as a found row in its own tier
decisions.why: FR-003 defines E0 as an implementation that already matches; a departure is by definition E1+ work, and the spec's Edge Cases already rank what a fix exposes under the tier it takes. Nothing is dropped and the research is not moved: the code change is ranked toward the research (FR-004), and E1 is the next tier taken.
